whenToUse: AI answers that take a few seconds to complete.
You want to show the first characters fast to shorten the wait.
It must be possible to stop midway.
whenNotToUse: Short answers that come out at once.
Formats best viewed when complete, such as tables or code.

alternatives.name: Typewriter
alternatives.reason: Typing out a fixed sentence for effect.

alternatives.name: Thinking Indicator
alternatives.reason: The wait before the first character.

accessibility: Keep aria-busy on while writing so the finished answer is read at once.
The cursor is decorative, so it's aria-hidden, and it doesn't blink with reduced motion.
The stop button sits in the same spot as the send button.
Use white-space: pre-wrap to keep line breaks.
